notes.title: Celebrate with us first Sprout Valley's anniversary!
notes.content:
[h2]Congratulations Nico! Find out what gifts are waiting in Ostara for the first anniversary of Sprout Valley!
Thank you for this exciting year! Over 140 000 players have found respite at Nico's side on his journey through Ostara – land that is now bustling with life like never before! 

The first anniversary is no small occasion! Therefore, on the occasion of this uncommon event, from today, plenty of additional content awaits you! Check it out for yourself! 💚[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/460df9a7dea2fc42d2e8ff9c3545a6d6105cc6de.png[/img]

So what await you in the anniversary update? From today you can change Nico's appearance and use a new emoji. From 8th of September, you'll be able to play with new pet and Sprays with a lot of drawings!

Do you prefer a Cactus 🌵 or maybe a Panda 🐼? There will be 20 brand-new Nico skins to choose from! Robot, Zombie or Pumpkin? A little hint: You don't have to decide on one you can change them every day at will! 

🎉 🥳 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/aab21e017ea84c0f40d816f5fffc8b235f27d2f9.png[/img]

From September 8th we will welcome Momo, the new adorable sidekick, who has unique skills that you'll love while harvesting! 🌱

Picking all the items from the ground and placing them immediately in their inventory is a snap for him! Collecting resources has never been so enjoyable! 🌿

Or maybe you'll feel that it is time for a change in decoration? A new Sprays tool coming on the anniversary date and will then come to their aid. You can use it to create various patterns on the ground from an extensive library! Is anyone dreaming of a floor decorated with stars? Here you go!

And all the excitement about the new update you can express with a brand new Nico emoji!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/8570d543bf1ce7930bab527491432ee283b86631.png[/img]

[h3] The Skins DLC and emojis are available today as a patch and additional DLC.
Momo Pet and Sprays are going to be available from September 8th both in patch and DLC on Switch eShop and Steam!😍 

Sprout Valley is available on Nintendo eShop and Steam! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/e0fc13fabdfa94a8c1f3e789b89bdc76bb7476ec.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1964820/Sprout_Valley/

notes.title: Join another adventure with Sprout Valley at PixElated Festival!

[/h3]

notes.title: Start your vacation with Sprout Valley! A hot, huge summer patch update is live!

notes.title: RedDeer.Games presents a new, cozy, puzzle game - Tell Me Your Story 📖
notes.content:
[h3][b]RedDeer.Games announces developement of a new in house game - [i]Tell Me Your Story[/i] - proposition for every fan of story-driven, cozy & puzzle games! [/b][/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/9740fd7b2d093f1a8556098e40c9e72dc7fbff67.jpg[/img]

Amelia comes to her grandma's cottage for the summer, expecting to spend the warm months there knitting, gardening, and helping her out. Soon enough, the girl realizes that her grandma Rose's house is full of wonders, artifacts, and souvenirs from all around the world. 

And so begins a journey to the past via the tales and memories of a retired globetrotter – a side of Amelia’s grandma, that she had no idea about.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/5a0570940adae65b57d63025550b2a9dbeed5c45.jpg[/img]

In Tell Me Your Story, the players, together with Amelia, will be tasked with helping the elderly woman with everyday chores – that is until they will find a couple of interesting artifacts. 

This discovery will turn the summer vacation around and Rose's adventurous past will be unearthed in the form of colorful memories.

To follow the story, the players will solve region-themed puzzles, surrounded by the hand-drawn scenery. There will be over 70 different types of riddles, neatly separated into 3 chapters related to Rose’s travels. Visiting South America's rainforests, the Chinese province of Yunnan, and the track of Orient Express' first route – that’s what players can expect.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/3f66393b0ce00aee6bc61123985dcbc72e205ea4.jpg[/img]

Tell Me Your Story has eye-catching and cozy visuals, that fit perfectly with the theme of getting to know the past of one's family. Those tales will be powered by Amelia's vivid imagination – which conveys the wordless game’s story perfectly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/bdafd80507fdf0732489c23bdcd9e671afc91026.gif[/img]
[h2]Tell Me Your Story will be available on Steam and Nintendo Switch in 2024

You can wishlist the game now! 
[/h2]

notes.title: Sit back and relax after a hard day
notes.content:
[h2]Sprout Valley the best place to reset after a long day[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/21f2e86d2c968facad1876e13f3230e559591fc1.png[/img]

[b]Sprout Valley[/b] is designed with relaxation and rejuvenation in mind, making it the primary focus of the game. By immersing players in the tranquil world of gardening, fishing, and forging connections with charming characters, the game serves as a soothing escape from the stresses of a hectic day. The meditative gameplay of cultivating plants, tending to the garden, and fishing in picturesque waters offers a sense of peace and harmony that allows players to unwind and find solace. With its captivating visuals, enchanting soundtrack, and serene landscapes, Sprout Valley provides a much-needed respite, offering players the chance to take a deep breath, recharge their spirits, and bask in the beauty of nature's wonders after a long and demanding day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/8f43fb218293225ccaf4c22fcdfe6e984b2432aa.png[/img]

One of the key aspects contributing to the game's relaxing ambiance is the procedurally generated levels. As players explore the ever-changing and diverse landscapes created from unique "seeds," they are continually greeted with new, mesmerizing vistas to explore and appreciate. The meditative gameplay is further enhanced by the option to share these enchanting locations with fellow players, fostering a sense of community and shared appreciation for the game's calming atmosphere. Whether players are tending to their gardens, engaging in leisurely fishing sessions, or forming meaningful bonds with in-game characters, [b]Sprout Valley[/b] offers a safe haven where they can disconnect from the outside world and find tranquility in the embrace of nature. It is this central focus on providing a relaxing and rejuvenating experience that makes Sprout Valley a perfect companion for players seeking a moment of peace and serenity after a long and arduous day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/5f7a1db2dd81602d01af89ef4bdefa5d37cbe4c7.png[/img]

notes.title: In-game buying and selling
notes.content:
[h2]Sprout Valley - Buying and selling is the key to business[/h2]

In [b]Sprout Valley[/b], players have the opportunity to engage in a thriving economy by selling and buying the resources they have gathered during their gardening and fishing endeavors. As they cultivate their garden and explore the serene landscapes, players will amass a variety of valuable resources. These resources can be sold in the in-game marketplace, where they can fetch fair prices based on their rarity and demand. By wisely managing their inventory and choosing the right time to sell, players can earn valuable coins to reinvest in their garden, acquire new tools, or even trade with other characters in the game. On the other hand, players can also browse the marketplace to purchase essential resources they may need to enhance their gardening skills or complete quests, fostering a sense of community and cooperation within the game world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/8b7634cb8dcb5d574abcaddb8ea84dcc279d93af.gif[/img]

Moreover, the dynamic nature of [b]Sprout Valley[/b] is enhanced by its procedurally generated levels. Each new level is created using a unique "seed," resulting in virtually endless combinations of islands and landscapes for players to explore and develop. Additionally, the prospect of sharing these seeds with other players adds a social dimension to the game. As players create their ideal gardens, they can choose to share the seeds of their favorite levels with the community, allowing fellow players to experience and enjoy the same picturesque landscapes they encountered. This sharing aspect fosters a sense of camaraderie among players, promoting creativity, and offering an exciting opportunity for the Sprout Valley community to bond over their shared love for nature and harmonious living. With the combination of resource trading and procedurally generated levels, Sprout Valley presents an engaging and ever-evolving gaming experience that invites players to immerse themselves in a world of endless possibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/7770d0763e16c93e447296c65591d45ae60a2c50.png[/img]

notes.title: Relaxing plant cultivation and cute graphics

From planting seeds to caring for each plant's unique needs, Sprout Valley lets players fully embrace their green thumbs and experience the joy of watching their garden bloom into a picturesque haven.

Moreover, as Nico explores this charming world, he will encounter various captivating characters and be able to forge meaningful connections with them.

notes.title: Hi, my name is Nico :3
notes.content:
[h2]Sprout Valley - new cute and relaxing game![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/3aefecf354e16b43876593f18279d234369bdf7a.png[/img]

[b]Sprout Valley[/b] is an exciting upcoming farming simulator game that offers players a refreshing escape from their busy lives, allowing them to immerse themselves in the soothing art of gardening and cultivate the garden of their dreams. With its captivating storyline and meticulously hand-crafted experience, the game promises an enchanting journey filled with discovery and wonder. Players assume the role of the adorable cat named Nico, the main character, as he embarks on a quest to find a tranquil place to call home. Along the way, Nico will encounter new friends and stumble upon intriguing events, unraveling the mysteries that the land of Ostara holds. As players help Nico navigate through the game's charming world, they will uncover the secrets and hidden treasures that await in Sprout Valley.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/b5f471fd00451c3f8a8cf4a24371b2337658446a.gif[/img]

Overall, [b]Sprout Valley[/b] promises to be a delightful and heartwarming gaming experience that combines the joys of farming simulation with a compelling narrative and a lovable protagonist. Whether it's tending to crops, nurturing relationships with newfound companions, or uncovering the ancient secrets of Ostara, players are sure to be captivated by the immersive and enchanting world that Sprout Valley has to offer. Get ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure with Nico as you dive into the beauty of nature and witness the magic of growth and friendship in this delightful farming simulator game.

notes.title: Sprout Valley takes part in the Wholesome Games festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/b73a1c15428b5afaef0e90cac3d93d411067951b.png[/img]

[h2]Check out Sprout Valley now during the Wholesome Games Festival![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/73766c1f7f3fa2ebc535b376c7dfa624a592f03b.png[/img]

"[b]Wholesome Games[/b] is a video game curation community with over 500,000 members across social media platforms. The community is best known for Wholesome Direct, a popular showcase of uplifting and thoughtful indie games.

One of the goals of Wholesome Games is to change how we think about which games are taken seriously. For many years, the most critically acclaimed titles have been the ones with the darkest themes and grimmest depictions of life, but there's also a whole world of hopeful video games with rich storytelling, innovative gameplay, and beautiful art and sound. We want to be a part of showcasing the breadth of experiences that games can have for players.

Wholesome Direct is an independent showcase organized by Wholesome Games. Each year the showcase features a selection of indie games that demonstrate the incredible range of themes, styles, and perspectives that games have to offer. Wholesome Direct 2023 will be streamed live on Saturday, June 10 at 9 AM PT via YouTube and Twitch."
